scope: Equipment: design: 19 F heating / 78 F cooling (sedro-woolley); heating load 25,039 Btuh, cooling 1.64 tons (room-by-room, Manual J method); unit house: 36k multi-zone outdoor, 5 wall heads (9k DINING, 6k OFFICE, 9k MASTER, 6k MEDIA, 6k BED. 2); cold-climate variable-capacity heat pump(s), A2L refrigerant, HSPF2 >= 9.0 per the WSEC credit

Rough-in: line sets 253 ft (concealed), condensate to daylight, communication cable; no ductwork (ductless); ventilation: exhaust 70.3 cfm continuous (WA M1505.4) - whole-house fan on a 24 h control, outdoor-air inlets; exhaust: every bath fan ducted and capped, dryer vent, range hood duct and cap - 47 ft

Trim, start-up and tests: registers and grilles, first filters, start-up and charge verification, controls set-up; tests: ventilation flow test, the permit load calculation; inspections: Mechanical rough-in (cover), Ventilation flow test, Final mechanical
